1.original_instruction: Visit the Monk Abbey (prt_monk), located one map East, one map North and two maps East of Prontera .
1.short_ru: Идите в Monk Abbey на prt_monk.
1.short_en: Go to the Monk Abbey on prt_monk.
1.full_ru: Идите в Monk Abbey (prt_monk): от Prontera пройдите одну карту на восток, одну на север и ещё две на восток.
1.full_en: Visit the Monk Abbey (prt_monk), located one map East, one map North and two maps East of Prontera .

2.original_instruction: Talk to Guarding Monk (58,247) then to Sensei Moohae (245,104). If you meet the qualifications, he will give you the first test, item collecting.
2.short_ru: На prt_monk поговорите с Guarding Monk (58,247), затем Sensei Moohae (245,104).
2.short_en: On prt_monk, talk to Guarding Monk (58,247), then Sensei Moohae (245,104).
2.full_ru: Поговорите с Guarding Monk (58,247), затем с Sensei Moohae (245,104). Если требования выполнены, он даст первое испытание — сбор предметов.

5.original_instruction: Elder Touha will have you remember one of the following: | And sheperds we shall be, for thee my lord for thee. Power path decended forth from the hand so our feet may swiftly carry out thy command and we shall flow a river forth thee and teeming with souls shall it ever be. In nomine Patris, et Filii et Spiritus Sancti. | I seek the path of enlightenment. We monks shall hold true to what we believe and will help protect others through the teachings we learn through our lives. In nomine Patris, et Filii et Spiritus Sancti. | I commit myself to veritas and aequitas. I will follow my path to enlightenment and purity. I will protect my brothers with life. Evil shall never be victorious while I breathe. In nomine Patris, et Filii et Spiritus Sancti. She will read entire passage out before allowing you to recite it. There is no penalty for failing; you can simply retry the test. Once complete, you will be sent to Boohae, located at (prt_monk 57, 179), on the bottom left side of the map.

6.original_instruction: Boohae will give you the option of two tests: Marathon and Mushroom collecting ( This test is recommended over the Marathon, because is less risky. ). Later, the player may return to Boohae to change the test, if it is needed. Left : The Marathon track for step 7a including the holes. Right : The Maze for Step 8. Randomly picks 1 of the 3 mazes. 7a. If you choose "Marathon": Talk to the door keeper in front of the Abby at (prt_monk 192,170). After, enter the building and find Bashu. Tell him "Marathon". He will then send you to another area. Run around this map without falling into the pits for many laps (about 10) to complete the Marathon test. The map is shaped like a ring, with occasional holes that players can fall into. This test is easier to complete by lowering the camera angle very low (Ctrl+Shift+mouse wheel up), allowing pits far ahead to be seen easily. Note that disconnecting will send you back to your save point. After the test is completed with the needed amount of laps,you will automatically be sent out. It takes approximately 30 minutes with Increase Agility to complete. Skip to Step 8. 7b. Talk to Bashu in the bottom left building. Building door is at (prt_monk 192, 170). Choose "Collect Mushrooms": you will be sent to another map where you must hunt two types of mushrooms (Gooey & Orange). The NPC does not tell the player that they have enough mushrooms until they have 30 of either type of mushroom. The mushrooms from the Thief test can also be used. While it is possible to have a prospective Thief gather the mushrooms, it should be easier to have an Acolyte with high agility and buffs to complete this test faster. It is best to do this bare-handed for maximum ASPD (since the damage is 1 even with a weapon). The NPC to exit is located at (prt_monk 224, 180)
6.short_ru: У Boohae выберите Marathon или сбор 30 грибов одного типа: Gooey или Orange.
6.short_en: Choose Marathon with Boohae or collect 30 mushrooms of one type: Gooey or Orange.
6.full_ru: Boohae предложит два испытания: Marathon или сбор грибов Mushroom collecting; сбор грибов рекомендуется как менее рискованный. При необходимости можно вернуться к Boohae и сменить испытание. Слева показана трасса Marathon для этапа 7a с ямами, справа — лабиринт для Step 8. Случайно выбирается 1 из 3 лабиринтов. 7a. Если выбран Marathon, поговорите с door keeper перед Abby (prt_monk 192,170), затем войдите и найдите Bashu. Скажите ему «Marathon»: он перенесёт вас в другую область. Нужно пройти много кругов, примерно 10, не падая в ямы на кольцевой трассе. Для обзора ям рекомендуется опустить камеру сочетанием Ctrl+Shift+mouse wheel up. Отключение вернёт вас в точку сохранения. После нужного числа кругов вас автоматически выведет. С Increase Agility прохождение занимает примерно 30 минут. Перейдите к Step 8 исходного руководства. 7b. Поговорите с Bashu в здании снизу слева; вход — prt_monk 192, 170. Выберите «Collect Mushrooms»: вас отправят на другую карту собирать грибы двух типов, Gooey и Orange. NPC сообщит о достаточном количестве, когда у вас будет 30 грибов одного из этих типов. Подойдут и грибы из Thief test. Их может собрать будущий Thief, но Acolyte с высокой ловкостью и усилениями, вероятно, справится быстрее. Лучше действовать без оружия ради максимальной ASPD: даже с оружием урон равен 1. NPC для выхода находится на prt_monk 224, 180.

7.original_instruction: Now locate Tomoon, also found indoors within the Abbey (prt_monk 192, 170) inside what appears to be a glowing cross. He sends you to an invisible maze. Be warned that during this test, monsters will spawn, such as Zombies and Mummies. They should not be much of a challenge, but keep in mind that you don't have much maneuvering area here. It is possible to check if a certain cell is passable by pointing the cursor at it. Walkable cells will have the usual green walk marker; if there is none, then that cell is blocked. Generally, try sticking to a straight line from the door to the exit. If there is a choice of routes, take the one that goes closer to the center line. Patience is highly required. Disconnecting in this test will send a player back to their save point.
7.short_ru: У Tomoon войдите в невидимый лабиринт; проверяйте проходимость клеток зелёным маркером.
7.short_en: Enter Tomoon's invisible maze; use the green walk marker to check passable cells.
7.full_ru: Найдите Tomoon внутри Abbey (prt_monk 192, 170), в месте, похожем на светящийся крест. Он отправит вас в невидимый лабиринт. Там появляются Zombies и Mummies: они не должны быть большой проблемой, но места для манёвра мало. Наведите курсор на клетку: проходимая клетка показывает обычный зелёный маркер, непроходимая — нет. Старайтесь двигаться прямо от входа к выходу; при выборе пути держитесь ближе к центральной линии. Потребуется терпение. Отключение вернёт вас в точку сохранения.

requirements.evidence: Boohae will give you the option of two tests: Marathon and Mushroom collecting ( This test is recommended over the Marathon, because is less risky. ). Later, the player may return to Boohae to change the test, if it is needed. Left : The Marathon track for step 7a including the holes. Right : The Maze for Step 8. Randomly picks 1 of the 3 mazes. 7a. If you choose "Marathon": Talk to the door keeper in front of the Abby at (prt_monk 192,170). After, enter the building and find Bashu. Tell him "Marathon". He will then send you to another area. Run around this map without falling into the pits for many laps (about 10) to complete the Marathon test. The map is shaped like a ring, with occasional holes that players can fall into. This test is easier to complete by lowering the camera angle very low (Ctrl+Shift+mouse wheel up), allowing pits far ahead to be seen easily. Note that disconnecting will send you back to your save point. After the test is completed with the needed amount of laps,you will automatically be sent out. It takes approximately 30 minutes with Increase Agility to complete. Skip to Step 8. 7b. Talk to Bashu in the bottom left building. Building door is at (prt_monk 192, 170). Choose "Collect Mushrooms": you will be sent to another map where you must hunt two types of mushrooms (Gooey & Orange). The NPC does not tell the player that they have enough mushrooms until they have 30 of either type of mushroom. The mushrooms from the Thief test can also be used. While it is possible to have a prospective Thief gather the mushrooms, it should be easier to have an Acolyte with high agility and buffs to complete this test faster. It is best to do this bare-handed for maximum ASPD (since the damage is 1 even with a weapon). The NPC to exit is located at (prt_monk 224, 180)

reviews.detail: Pinned HTML restores seven three-material sets. Only one assigned set is prepared, and return is the same obligation. Three memory passages keep original spelling/Latin text; source does not establish one paste field or line-by-line options. Retry without penalty applies only to the memory test.

Marathon and mushrooms are alternatives and may be changed via Boohae. Approximate ten laps/thirty minutes with Increase Agility are not a fixed exact count, deadline or required buff. Mushrooms need thirty of either one type, not thirty of each or a kill quota; Gooey/Orange item IDs and consumption remain unverified.

Source Step 8 refers to the maze represented by archived stage 7. One of three maze variants is picked, not all three completed. Caption layout is not another movement objective. Hazards are not compulsory kills. The printed mushroom exit map/point is retained with scene uncertainty; the Abbey entrance is not an interior actor coordinate.

Green Potion is provided then drunk, not an advance purchase; its ID is not guessed. Knuckle Duster 1804 has an explicit Job Level 50 phrase. Waghnak 1801 has no separately explicit level range, and the whole or/if wording is ambiguous; both are possible source alternatives, not a fabricated deterministic below-50 rule or two rewards.
